imageNotes: Twelve native public account stills selected: eleven scarf photographs plus one modest outfit Reel cover. Scarf photos are grouped into eight editorial product cards including the outfit; grouped photographs describe a palette edit, not a verified same-SKU variant set. Do not infer silk, satin or other fibre content. All prices and exact sizes are unverified. No generated products, extracted video frames or invented stock.
designRecommendation: Create an elegant scarf gallery with deep forest typography, clean ivory-white panels and a restrained gold accent responding to the public display photographs. Give every scarf image a complete portrait frame. Use an airy horizontal colour-story section and a larger personal-styling image. WhatsApp enquiries should carry the selected photographed scarf name, without invented textile specifications or inventory.
commercialFit: An image-led searchable collection with saved favourites and item-specific enquiries can help customers browse beyond the Instagram feed. Current sizes, stock and prices should be confirmed by the boutique; do not invent checkout, payment or fulfilment capability.
